prompt:
My local AI assistant has been accumulating daily notes in its memory folder for the past couple of days (January 9th and 10th). I need you to perform a full memory maintenance cycle on the workspace located at `/workspace/.openclaw/workspace`.

Specifically:
1. Go through those daily notes and extract everything useful — preferences, lessons, project updates, tool configs, domain knowledge, reference links — and make sure the appropriate core knowledge files are updated accordingly. Don't lose anything that's already in those files.
2. Once you've processed the notes, archive them properly and clean up the raw logs from the inbox.
3. Finally, make sure the global memory index reflects all the important changes that were made.

The system already has a defined structure and routing rules for where each type of information should go. Please follow the established conventions for this workspace.
